title: finding(test-infra): two whole-corpus tests in check-doc-links.test.ts run at 3-4x of the 15s default and time out under container load
body:
Found while running the objectui#8043 gate battery (branch `claude/issue-8043-half-state-patrol-doc-knob`, session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`). Out of scope for that card and deliberately not fixed there. Routing, `domain:*` and grading are the triage seat's; this seat applies only `finding`.

## What happened

One `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` on a contended container:

```
FAIL  scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts > the anchor rule is the renderers' own … >
      agrees with the real renderers on every heading in the scan surface
      Error: Test timed out in 15000ms.
FAIL  … > has no setext headings, which the ATX-only scan would not see
      Error: Test timed out in 15000ms.

Test Files  1 failed | 110 passed (111)
     Tests  2 failed | 3329 passed (3331)   Duration 188.36s
```

The same command on the same tree, minutes earlier, was `111 passed (111)` / `3331 passed (3331)` in 118.36s. Nothing in the diff under test touches `check-doc-links.test.ts` or anything it reads. The variable was container load: three agent worktrees building and testing at once.

## Why it is close to the edge, measured

Run alone with `--reporter=verbose`, the whole file is 121 tests in 12.5s and these two are most of it:

```
4429ms  agrees with the real renderers on every heading in the scan surface
3792ms  has no setext headings, which the ATX-only scan would not see
 586ms  reproduces github-slugger exactly, over every non-surrogate code point
```

Against vitest's 15000ms default that is 3.4x and 4.0x of headroom on an idle box — which is not much, because the work is not bounded by anything the test controls. Both tests walk every `SCAN_ROOTS` entry (the run above reports over 150 `docs`-rule files and over 50 `disk`-rule files) and `await getTableOfContents(...)` on each one, i.e. a full remark/MDX parse per file. They do it **twice**: each test builds the corpus independently, so the same ~230 documents are parsed once for the anchor comparison and again for the setext sweep.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a shrug

The cost also grows with the doc tree — every page added to `content/docs` widens both loops — so the headroom shrinks on its own without anyone touching this file, and the failure mode is a red on a PR that changed nothing near it. This repository has already ruled on what that trains people to do (objectui#6596: a check red on the healthy case trains everyone to ignore red).

## The direction AGENTS.md already points

Its testing-discipline section is explicit that raising the timeout is not the fix, and that the remedy is moving unbounded work out of the bounded window: cost paid at module scope is "not constrained by any test/hook timeout". Here that reads as computing the parsed corpus **once**, at module scope, and having both tests assert over it — which also removes the duplicated parse rather than merely hiding it. `beforeAll` is explicitly the wrong home (`hookTimeout` is 10s, narrower than the 15s it would replace).

⚠️ Not verified by this seat: whether any other file in `scripts/__tests__` sits in the same band. The two above are simply the two that failed; the census was not run.

## Dedup

The PM seat read the full open `domain:devx` set for objectui at 2026-09-06T09:19Z (76 open) and the lane list again at 12:55Z. This seat re-read only the increment: repo-scoped REST `GET /issues?state=open&since=2026-09-06T12:55:00Z` returned 22 items, control present (objectui#8043, this seat's own card, is in the list), and none of them is this. Cards older than that read are covered by the PM's, not by this one.
